agreements: V7 preserves exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP: THINK owns the continuing waking thought-action-public-outcome stream, DREAM is disposable context management, and SLEEP compiles and writes only grounded propositions already authored by the continuing child.

The birth bootstrap, parent controllers, support resolver, constructor, stager, evaluator, lineage store, exams, auditors, gates, authority verifier, and release controller are laboratory infrastructure rather than additional cognitive organs.

Parenting and repetition remain thinker-side waking interventions; only a later independent complete child commit with same-life public grounding may reach SLEEP, never parent, repetition, or DREAM artifacts or their direct or derived observables.

Fresh-from-immutable-birth personal construction with a zero-effective-delta initializer, full cumulative eligible evidence, postclosure staging, preservation evaluation, and a single atomic full-head promotion is the correct intended lineage architecture.

Delta_R is a T-versus-D immediate selective-advice-use interaction; Delta_F and Delta_E are root-randomized entry-normalized developmental AUC interactions for total regimes, not mediation, parenting-only, repetition, or intrinsic-learning-rate estimands.

Held-out extraction plus native action and the declared negative controls are necessary for any future extractability claim; source fit, recitation, static audits, canary margins, six roots, or receipt presence are insufficient.

The exact bootstrap rendering, support representation, finite coverage and dose, statistical analysis, stopping, safety, and held-out native-use scope may remain separately frozen future contracts only while every first affected action fails closed until those exact bytes and required evidence exist.

All results and all twenty-one acceptance obligations are prospective and unevaluated, and these exact bytes authorize no ratification, intake transition, implementation, model, tokenizer, data, adapter, checkpoint, CPU/GPU, external science, claim, publication, push, or release action.

disagreements.issue: Whether six shared phase receipt IDs and one global required_before value can encode 126 distinct test-by-phase obligations in a noncircular order.

positions.position: Each phase-wide receipt may stand for every acceptance test, and implementation may remain the global required_before value.
A singular test_id receipt cannot represent twenty-one rows, and dynamic phases cannot precede the implementation or evidence they exercise.

resolution.rationale: The exact schema binds one test_id, while downstream actions consume only one shared ID; one row can therefore masquerade as all rows. The global implementation label also contradicts the declared phased construction order.
resolution.selected_position: Require exactly one unique child receipt for every applicable test_id-by-phase_id row and an equality-bound complete phase manifest, with every phase attached to its actual first consumer.
resolution.required_change: In the successor, define the complete expected row set, unique row identities and roots, phase-manifest schemas and producers, and missing/duplicate/extra/aliased/stale/wrong-action substitution rejection. Replace every global required_before value with phase-specific first-consumer bindings; no dynamic row may precede its implementation or result producer.

disagreements.issue: Whether the exact registry is closed when it contains an undefined lifetime, omitted source products, and stale producer names.

positions.position: Artifact producer_policy prose and capability entries suffice to establish closed-world production.
Every lifetime and producer reference must resolve consistently across lifetime, artifact, source, capability, bridge, schema, and operation registries.

resolution.rationale: IMMUTABLE_SEALED_V1 is undefined; required frozen artifacts and G0 manifest are absent from X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE.produces; promotion receipt production and legacy E4/E5 producer names disagree. Prose cannot repair these exact-byte contradictions.
resolution.selected_position: Regenerate a referentially and producer-closed registry with exactly one consistent producer and a declared lifetime for every artifact.
resolution.required_change: Register IMMUTABLE_SEALED_V1 or replace every use with a declared lifetime; add all frozen contracts, initializer, matched-solo receipt, analysis packet, G0 manifest, and promotion receipt to their sole sources; replace E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER and E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT remnants; reject unknown lifetimes, principals, operations, schemas, missing source products, or producer cardinality/mismatch.

disagreements.issue: Whether separate candidate, trace, and descriptor writes structurally establish that staging begins only after complete candidate closure.

positions.position: The constructor/stager principal split and descriptor bridge establish postclosure staging.
An independently writable descriptor can appear before candidate or trace closure, and the unconsumed trace cannot be audited.

resolution.rationale: T062 is triggered by the descriptor write alone and equality-binds neither terminal candidate bytes nor a complete trace. This is a fatal ordering hole in the promised constructor/stager separation.
resolution.selected_position: Publish staging authority only from one atomic seal or a closure manifest equality-binding terminal candidate, complete trace, contracts, seed, and terminal state.
resolution.required_change: Add the seal operation or closure-manifest schema, producer, bridge, audit receipt, and crash-state rules. The descriptor must remain unavailable after a candidate-only or trace-only write and until all terminal roots close; the lineage audit must observe a narrow closure proof without candidate content.

disagreements.issue: Whether naming PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC and its linearizable semantics supplies an exact wire and retry contract.

positions.position: The registered operation name and semantics are sufficient for later implementation.
Canonical request/result schemas and a durable request-digest idempotency state machine are required before atomicity and retry safety are constructible.

resolution.rationale: The referenced PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC schemas are absent from operation_bodies and operation_results, leaving request fields, committed response, denial, replay, and crash recovery undefined.
resolution.selected_position: Define the complete CAS request/result bytes and one durable request-digest-to-result transaction state machine.
resolution.required_change: Bind expected complete head, staged candidate, verdict, replacement root, namespace, nonce, idempotency key, request digest, committed result, and promotion receipt. Specify concurrent promotion, stale head, identical retry after lost response, conflicting key reuse, substitution, and crash before/after the single linearization point; all noncommits preserve head and life.

disagreements.issue: Whether implementing audit/release machinery is equivalent to executing the real manifest, audit, verifier, wrapper, tuple, and transfer chain.

positions.position: Implementation existence, external release authority, review, and external-science completion suffice for opaque transfer.
Every real manifest, audit attestation, wrapper binding, authority verdict, tuple equality, and transfer needs an explicit ordered producer action and typed receipt.

resolution.rationale: The 44-action DAG contains no real manifest-sealer, auditor, wrapper-registration, or authority-verifier actions, and release consumes none of their promised products. The narrated release loop is therefore bypassed.
resolution.selected_position: Make the complete runtime release chain explicit and require its exact terminal verdict and class/root-bound nine-field tuple before one opaque transfer.
resolution.required_change: Add separately authorized ordered actions and unique receipts for dependency and dispatcher manifest sealing, blindness audit, lineage audit, deterministic narrow attestations, exact wrapper registration, external authorization, authority verification, nine-field tuple equality, and transfer. Reject missing, failed, stale, substituted, expired, replayed, or class/root-mismatched inputs end to end.

disagreements.issue: Whether generic phase completion and late analysis-packet use producer-close GPU dispatch, reporting, and scientific claims.

positions.position: Generic G2/G3/G4 pass receipts plus human authority and an analysis packet at claim time are sufficient.
Each named scientific prerequisite must be a uniquely produced typed edge to its first affected action, and reporter invocation itself must consume the exact packet.

resolution.rationale: Free-form prerequisite lists are not DAG edges. GPU dispatch lacks explicit target-blindness, semantic-control, and noninterference receipts; claim-phase execution can manufacture a generic pass without powered evidence; generic exam actions can report before packet binding.
resolution.selected_position: Require exact test-row/evidence manifests at GPU, reporter, and claim boundaries and separate executor, scorer, and reporter actions.
resolution.required_change: Gate GPU dispatch on typed target-blindness, bootstrap semantic-control, and static/runtime noninterference rows. Gate reporting on the frozen analysis packet and exact score/assignment/root/arm/age/endpoint/estimand/missingness/safety/multiplicity/code/label roots. Gate claims on consumed, not self-produced, powered root-level endpoint, interval, multiplicity, missingness, stopping, safety, authorship, extraction/native-use, control, and claim-specific evidence.

disagreements.issue: Whether one-shot umbrella actions and one matched-solo receipt can govern every repeated developmental invocation.

positions.position: Generic CPU, SLEEP, exam, and GPU actions may contain all repeated calls under one action receipt.
Every root, arm, life, age, epoch, call, resolution, SLEEP, retry, and exam needs a finite exact instance or sealed child sub-DAG with its own bindings.

resolution.rationale: One-shot generic actions hide the very repeated calls for which opportunity equality, epoch closure, nonreplay, and producer identity must be verified; the resolver is not explicitly executed at all.
resolution.selected_position: Expand the finite action space or bind a sealed, validated per-instance sub-DAG before any protected invocation.
resolution.required_change: Enumerate root, arm, life, age, epoch, principal, invocation, retry, and result identity for each model, parent, DREAM, support-resolver/monitor, SLEEP constructor/stager/evaluator/CAS, executor, scorer, reporter, CPU, GPU, and external-science action. Each child must consume exact authority, phase, contract, matched-opportunity, expiry/replay, and producer receipts before its first token, call, write, or allocation.

disagreements.issue: Whether a single exact G0 authorization prerequisite protects seven actions when result schemas do not echo the trust-root bytes.

positions.position: The shared authorization and prose echo requirement bind all G0 components through gate installation.
The manifest must be a registered source product and every per-action authorization/result and final gate receipt must mechanically echo all authorized roots.

resolution.rationale: R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT binds one action_id but gates seven actions; produced receipts have no echo schemas; G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST is neither source-produced nor consumed. Component substitution is therefore not excluded.
resolution.selected_position: Use one consumed exact harness manifest plus per-action child authorization, or a complete authorized-action manifest, and echo-close every G0 result through installation.
resolution.required_change: Register and consume G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST; bind registry, DAG, parser, issuer, bridge, validator, gate, fake artifacts/dispatchers, faults, allowed paths, forbidden scope, expected outputs, action, scope, nonce, and expiry. Define every child and installed-gate receipt schema and reject each substituted, omitted, mixed, stale, or permissive root.

disagreements.issue: Whether the 31-by-98 capability Cartesian product and fixed byte lengths establish complete noninterference.

positions.position: One visible consumer per capability and fixed-size outputs close all direct, derived, and covert access.
The universe omits sources, payloads, receipts, rows, actions, results, and observables, while arbitrary fixed-size values and timing can still encode findings.

resolution.rationale: Cartesian completeness over capability IDs documents only that subset. It omits multiple authority-bearing flows and does not constrain attestation values, roots, nonce/time selection, ordering, omission, retries, caches, error shapes, or timing.
resolution.selected_position: Generate one closed visibility universe from every registry and DAG object and constrain every observer-visible value and behavioral channel.
resolution.required_change: Include artifacts and payloads, source issuance, capabilities, bridges, actions, external/produced/test receipts and manifests, results, errors, count, order, timing, cache, and terminal outputs with exact producer/consumer/observer permissions. Freeze canonical finite attestation fields/values, deterministic padding, nonce/time policy, deadlines, retry/cache/error behavior, and test that detailed findings cannot alter verifier-visible bits beyond declared verdict facts.

disagreements.issue: Whether paired D/T schooling identifies a teachability or learning-readiness mechanism and permits saying T confers receptivity without prospective control-strength criteria.

positions.position: The active control distinguishes learning-readiness from task skill, and powered Delta_R permits saying T confers selective receptivity.
The design identifies the complete T-rendering versus D-rendering advice-effect interaction, which may reflect ordinary reasoning, representation, compliance, D damage, ceiling, or unequal headroom.

resolution.rationale: The intended computation is not isolated from every other semantic and gradient consequence of the T rendering, and M0 reporting alone does not establish that D is nondamaged or D/T headroom is comparable.
resolution.selected_position: Treat teachability and learning-readiness only as intervention nicknames; formally report the T-versus-D incremental immediate selective-advice-use interaction and total-regime AUC effect modification.
resolution.required_change: Remove mechanism-identification language from rationale, thesis, claims, tests, and report labels. Before any 'conferred by T' wording, prospectively freeze and satisfy powered D/T/M0 entry competence, damage, ceiling, headroom, equivalence or noninferiority endpoints and margins; otherwise report only the relative complete-rendering contrast.

disagreements.issue: Whether bootstrap rendering, model-free support, finite-dose/statistics, and native-use details must exist in these proposal bytes or may remain future exact contracts.

positions.position: Every unresolved scientific implementation and analysis detail is itself a fatal V7 proposal defect.
These may remain separately deliberated, human-authorized exact contracts because V7 expressly makes them pre-action fail-closed prerequisites and claims no result.

resolution.rationale: The proposal establishes prospective contract classes and forbids present evidentiary credit. Requiring all later model/data/statistical bytes now would improperly conflate architecture with separately authorized science, but the repaired DAG must make their temporal gates exact.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the four scientific packages deferred and unevaluated, with no action or claim credit until their exact contracts, feasibility evidence, and tests are separately frozen and authorized.
resolution.required_change: Preserve exact pre-first-use gates for loss-bearing bootstrap tokenization/masks/filler/action encoding/weights/truncation/optimizer/environment randomness and target blindness; finite model-free support representation with reject-on-undecidable; coverage feasibility and ITT-compatible capacity stopping; root-level power/task scale/covariance/multiplicity/safety/missingness/sensitivity; and target-blind held-out cues, contamination, no retrieval, native action, and negative controls.

disagreements.issue: Whether systems repairs may alter the organism or route parent/repetition information directly into SLEEP.

positions.position: Repairs must preserve exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP and the sole waking child-mediated parenting/repetition path.
A new cognitive controller or direct parent/repetition-derived compiler input could simplify implementation.

resolution.rationale: The simpler three-function organism and credit boundary are the binding thesis and the coherent center shared by both interpretations; a shortcut would answer a different scientific question.
resolution.selected_position: All successor repairs remain laboratory infrastructure and preserve the waking-only causal route to independently authored, grounded child evidence.
resolution.required_change: Retain THINK as continuing waking cognition, DREAM as disposable context, and SLEEP as noncreative compilation/write. Add per-invocation fixed-parent exogeneity and waking-repetition tests proving identical scheduled bytes/timing/opportunity across histories and proving only a new complete child commit plus independent same-life public grounding can later enter SLEEP.
